Title: Is there a rule preventing multiple copies of biothaumaturgi

Messages.Author: Agamemnon
Messages.Body:
Biothaumaturgic Experiment
Type: Action
Requires: Thaumaturgy
Cost: 1 pool
+1 stealth action.
[tha] This minion employs an animal retainer from your hand (ignore requirements; pay cost as normal).
[THA] Put this card on a minion you control. The minion with this card gets an optional maneuver each combat and +1 strength.

is there anything that prevents me from placing multiple copies of this card on the same minion?

Hindsight is foresight because we walk in circles

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body: multiple copies on the same minion are ok!

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Agamemnon wrote:
> Biothaumaturgic Experiment
> Type: Action
> Requires: Thaumaturgy
> Cost: 1 pool
> +1 stealth action.
> [tha] This minion employs an animal retainer from your hand (ignore requirements; pay cost as normal).
> [THA] Put this card on a minion you control. The minion with this card gets an optional maneuver each combat and +1 strength.
>
> is there anything that prevents me from placing multiple copies of this card on the same minion?
>
Apart from the NRA, no.
NRA prevents you from performing the same action with the same vampire more than once each turn.
